object.name: evi.svfsynth~
object.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF multimode synth filter with oversampling options
object.description: Beefy nonlinear TPT SVF filter with choice of 12/24dB slope, audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities. Morphing 12dB filter output is always available at the far left outlet. Optionally morphing 24dB filter output is avaiable at the far right outlet. Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance for interesting effects.
object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear SVF filters in evieve, see the 'evieve svf' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance for interesting effects, at which point the filter can go out of tune.

outlets.description: 24dB SVF filter outputs if @slope attribute is on.

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (off, default).

attributes.name: filtinterp
attributes.description: 0=Lowpass, 0.5=Bandpass, 1=Highpass. Smoothly interpolate filter output between these states.

attributes.name: filtinterpsmooth
attributes.description: If filtinterpsmooth > 0, the @filtinterp attribute will be internally smoothed by this time.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: A shaping parameter for the internal saturation. It is advised never to touch this and leave it at it's default.

attributes.name: shapesmooth
attributes.description: If shapesmooth > 0, the @shape attribute will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off.

attributes.name: slope
attributes.description: If 0 (default) only the 12dB filters are available at the far left outlet. If 1, additional 24dB filters are avilable at the far right outlet. Switching on 24dB filters doubles the CPU usage.

attributes.name: tunesmooth
attributes.description: A very strange attribute. Smooths the retuning algorithm if resonance is > 1. Can be turned off (set to 0.) if resonance > 1 is never used.
